title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: We collect as little data as possible, and you stay in control.

s1.title: Data we store
s1.body: Email, username, display name, a password hash (never the password itself), preferences, round and virtual-wallet records, session durations, and — only when personalisation is on — optional behavioural events such as games viewed.

s2.title: What the data is used for
s2.body: Running your account and virtual wallet, showing your history and statistics, enforcing healthy-play features, recommending games, and keeping the service secure. We do not sell data or share it with advertisers.

s3.title: What we do not do
s3.body: We do not use individual data to increase play intensity, target players after losses, infer psychological vulnerability for commercial purposes, alter game odds, or reduce break reminders.

s4.title: Cookies
s4.body: We use a single essential cookie (__session) to keep you signed in. It is HttpOnly and is not used for ad tracking.

s5.title: Your controls
s5.body: You can turn off personalisation, reset your recommendation profile and delete optional behavioural history any time in Profile. You can also delete your account in Settings.

s6.title: Retention & deletion
s6.body: Optional behavioural events are deleted when you ask or turn off personalisation. When an account is deleted, personal data is anonymised; virtual coin transaction records are kept without identity for audit integrity. Admin audit logs are retained for accountability.

s7.title: Security
s7.body: Passwords are hashed with scrypt, sessions use random tokens stored only as hashes, and every balance operation is performed by the server in an atomic transaction. No system is perfect; report vulnerabilities via support.
